hero.title: Learn a new language,
hero.lead: FliksLingo turns language learning into a daily habit with short gamified lessons, spoken audio and real cultural context.

languagesSection.heading: Choose your language
languagesSection.subheading: From global favourites to African languages you will not find everywhere.

featuresSection.heading: Everything you need to stay motivated
featuresSection.subheading: Built to make practice feel like play.

features.title: Gamified lessons
features.text: Earn XP, keep streaks alive and protect your hearts as you move through bite-sized units.

features.title: Hear it spoken
features.text: Native-style pronunciation for every phrase, so you learn to speak, not just read.

features.title: Smart flashcards
features.text: Flip through 3D cards with phonetics and example sentences, and track what you have mastered.

features.title: Culture vault
features.text: Daily proverbs, etiquette tips and street slang that bring each language to life.

features.title: Five quiz styles
features.text: Multiple choice, sentence builder, matching, listening and fill-in-the-blank.

features.title: Friendly competition
features.text: Climb the weekly leaderboard and see how you rank against other learners.

steps.title: Pick a language
steps.text: Choose from 12 languages across Europe, Asia and Africa.

steps.title: Learn in minutes
steps.text: Short lessons with audio, quizzes and instant feedback.

steps.title: Build the habit
steps.text: Keep your daily streak, review flashcards and level up.
